subject: Pilot economics and next steps — FluxPay discovery
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot economics and next steps — FluxPay discovery

Nora — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and to make next steps explicit. I’ve kept this focused on the cost / TCO levers we discussed.

Key pains you confirmed:
- Token spend variability during peak hours is the primary budget risk — engineering can’t predict monthly tokens from usage spikes.
- Some latency spikes (p95) are impacting UX on heavy reconciliation flows.
- Procurement timeline: finance needs a clear pilot budget by mid-August to approve a Q3 POC.

Goals you called out:
1) Prove a predictable cost envelope for the main reconciliation pipeline (goal: ~40–60M tokens/month)
2) Achieve 3–4x effective unit-cost reduction for “batchable” flows via batching/caching + model selection, while keeping p50 latency <= 200ms for interactive flows
3) Have a short pilot (6–8 weeks) with clear success criteria that can be used to request a commit for Dedicated capacity if results look good

Immediate actionables (owners & rough dates):
- FluxPay: confirm expected steady-state QPS and average prompt/response token counts (Nora; due: 2025-07-07)
- Redwood: produce a simple TCO worksheet with a pilot configuration and ballpark ROI (Rishi; due: 2025-07-03) — attached: token-econ-worksheet.xlsx
- Joint: agree pilot success metrics and SLOs (two-week sync; target week of 2025-07-14)

Constraints / assumptions to highlight:
- You mentioned a hard pilot budget ceiling around $75k — any variance will need finance sign-off.
- We’ll estimate batching gains conservatively (we typically model a 2–3x improvement for eligible flows depending on request shape).

Proposed pilot structure (high level):
- 6-week pilot using hosted Redwood API with an opt-in cache and batching configuration tuned for reconciliation jobs.
- Run A/B for 2 weeks to measure quality delta on identical prompts before switching to production routing.
- Deliverable: a short ROI report + suggested Dedicated capacity sizing if commit criteria met.

Attachments: pilot-sow-outline.pdf (outline for pilot scope), token-econ-worksheet.xlsx (ballpark numbers — will update after you share token stats).

Ask: please reply with the token/QPS numbers and confirm the $75k pilot cap so I can finalize the ballpark TCO. If that budget number needs to move, flag me so we can discuss tradeoffs (duration vs throughput vs model choice).

Thanks — look forward to taking this to the next step.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Nora Patel <nora@fluxpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot economics and next steps — FluxPay discovery

Thanks Rishi — this looks like a good write-up. A few clarifications from our side:

- Budget: $75k is accurate as a firm cap for FY25 Q3 pilot funds. We could stretch to $90k only if the ROI is shown clearly within four weeks.
- Token estimate: the reconciliation job averages ~1,200 tokens per run today and runs roughly 25–40k times per day during business hours; there is a heavy tail on specific batch days (up to 80k runs). I’m attaching a small latency/export sample for the last 30 days (fluxpay-latency-sample.csv).
- Success metrics: finance will want a modeled 3x reduction in per-inference spend or demonstrable equivalent in reduced cloud charges.

We’re fine with the 6-week pilot structure; key ask is that you provide a clear comparison: current baseline ops cost vs expected Redwood-hosted pilot cost vs Dedicated-commit scenario.

I’ll get the QPS and token distribution exported and send by 7/7 — working with infra to pull precise numbers.

Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, FluxPay
nora@fluxpay.com

Attachment: fluxpay-latency-sample.csv
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot economics and next steps — Pilot economics and next steps — FluxPay discovery

Appreciate the quick reply and the sample — that helps. High-level ballpark based on the numbers you gave (will refine after your dataset):

Assumptions I used for this fast pass:
- Model: mid-sized open variant (quantized) — compatible with batching and KV cache
- Average tokens/request (current): 1,200 tokens
- Eligible for batching/caching: ~65% of runs are batchable (reconciliation jobs with repeated prefixes)
- Conservative batching uplift modeled: 2.5x cost reduction on batchable portion; KV prefix cache reduces prompt tokens on repeated runs by ~30% on average

Quick ballpark TCO (pilot, hosted):
- Baseline (your current cloud inference cost): estimated $120k/month (from your infra notes)
- Redwood-hosted pilot (projected): ~$40–55k/month depending on batch tuning and model variant (includes token/compute and modest data retention)
- If we convert to Dedicated after pilot and sustain batching/caching, effective unit cost could trend to the low-$0.0000x range per token (detailed number in worksheet once we finalize token distribution)

Next steps I’ll take this afternoon:
1) Update token-econ-worksheet.xlsx with the sample you attached and provide a 2-page pilot ROI memo (expected by 2025-07-03).
2) Draft the pilot SOW (pilot-sow-draft.pdf) showing milestones, data ingress, security requirements and success criteria (draft by 2025-07-06).
3) Set up a 30-minute working session for batching configuration review the week of 2025-07-14 — propose Wed 7/16 10am PT (I’ll send a calendar invite).

Links: I’ve started a shared Drive doc for the pilot plan — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-fluxpay-pilot-plan. I’ll put the detailed cost tables there once updated.

If finance is fixed at $75k we’ll explicitly show options that keep initial spend within that cap (shorter pilot duration vs narrower scope).

—
Rishi

Looping back with a quick internal checklist for the pilot so we don’t miss compliance asks (I’ll also add this to the Drive doc):

- Security artifacts: SOC 2 pack + app-level architecture diagram (owner: Camila; deliverable: 2025-07-06)
- Data ingress: confirm whether S3 pulls or secure upload endpoint (ask Nora in next meeting)
- Minimal data retention policy for pilot (default 30 days, can be shortened)
- Contact list for escalation: Nora, Rishi, Camila, Jordan — include legal if we need an emergency NDA tweak

I’ll prepare the SOC 2 evidence bundle and a concise one-pager security note to share with FluxPay before the pilot SOW.

—Camila
